blocks.text: Screenwriters Małgorzata Szumowska, Michał Englert, Kasper Bajon, Brid Arnstein
With Aimee Lou Wood, Johnny Flynn, Vicky Krieps
Languages English, French, German With English subtitles

Anna Dostoevsky loves her husband Fyodor. Fyodor loves his wife, but he also loves gambling and booze. Living in self-imposed exile in Germany, Fyodor’s biggest obstacle to creative progress is himself. Anna tries desperately to rid him of his procrastination so he can deliver a new novel and they can avoid destitution. Sending up the myth of the male genius, The Idiot(s) is also a beautiful love story about the writer and the wife that saved him.
Contains scenes of infant death, nudity, and sex.
